prompt.format: Create feature docs for this project from what is already there (README, code, documentation): docs/FEATURES.md with a short introduction and a table with one row per epic (link, topic, status), and one file per epic in docs/features/epic-XX-<slug>.md with a description, a line **Stories:**, a line **Status (date):** and stories such as **US-XXYY: Title** <status> followed by As a / in order to / I would like to, Epic, Priority, Complexity, Acceptance Criteria as checkboxes in the form Given/When/Then, Notes and Dependencies. Status markers: 📋 Planned, 🚧 In progress, ✅ Done (merged; add "Released in vX.Y.Z" when released). Order the epics by topic, not by release.
prompt.rule: Also add a project rule through AI-DLC's own way of saving rules, not by editing the memory files directly, so every AI tool in the project (Claude Code, opencode and the others) follows it: a new story the person describes goes into the right epic file right away; when work on a story starts, set it to 🚧 In progress in its status marker, the epic's **Status (…)** line and its FEATURES.md row; when it is built and approved, set it to ✅ Done and tick its met acceptance criteria; as soon as the release it goes into is known, write it out ("for vX.Y.Z", and "Released in vX.Y.Z" when the tag is cut); a delivered story never stays in progress.
prompt.exists: The project already has feature docs in {path} (an overview and one file per epic). {rule}

guards.title: Checks you can turn off
guards.confirmOff: Turn off the check "{name}"? AI-DLC then stops checking this until you turn it back on.

AIDLC_DISABLE_PLAN_APPROVAL_GUARD.name: Plan approval
AIDLC_DISABLE_PLAN_APPROVAL_GUARD.protects: Code Generation waits for your approval of its plan before it writes code.

AIDLC_DISABLE_REVIEW_FREEZE_HOOK.name: Review freeze
AIDLC_DISABLE_REVIEW_FREEZE_HOOK.protects: Files under review can't be changed until the review is done.

AIDLC_DISABLE_REVIEWER_SCOPE_HOOK.name: Reviewer read scope
AIDLC_DISABLE_REVIEWER_SCOPE_HOOK.protects: A reviewer reads only what it was asked to review.

AIDLC_DISABLE_SUMMARY_CONFIRMATION.name: Summary confirmation
AIDLC_DISABLE_SUMMARY_CONFIRMATION.protects: AI-DLC asks you to confirm its summary of a stage before it moves on.

AIDLC_SKIP_SUMMARY_CONFIRMATION_GUARD.name: Summary confirmation check
AIDLC_SKIP_SUMMARY_CONFIRMATION_GUARD.protects: A stage can't close until its summary was really confirmed.

AIDLC_SKIP_HUMAN_PRESENCE_GUARD.name: Human presence
AIDLC_SKIP_HUMAN_PRESENCE_GUARD.protects: An approval counts only when a person gave it.

AIDLC_SKIP_ARTIFACT_GUARD.name: Stage output
AIDLC_SKIP_ARTIFACT_GUARD.protects: A stage can't be completed without the files it must produce.

AIDLC_SKIP_REVISION_BACKSTOP.name: Revision backstop
AIDLC_SKIP_REVISION_BACKSTOP.protects: A stage can't be revised again and again without a person deciding.

AIDLC_DISABLE_ENSEMBLE_EVIDENCE.name: Pipeline handoff
AIDLC_DISABLE_ENSEMBLE_EVIDENCE.protects: Work handed from one agent to the next must carry its evidence.
